# Switch Statement

void main() {
  switch (x) {
    case 1:
      break;
  }
}

==>

Program(Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList,")",Block("{",Statement(SwitchStatement("switch","(",Identifier,")","{",SwitchLabel("case",Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Literal(NumberLiteral))),":"),Statement(BreakStatement("break",";")),"}")),"}"))))

# Assert & Rethrow

void main() {
  assert(x != null);
  rethrow;
}

==>

Program(Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList,")",Block("{",Statement(AssertStatement("assert","(",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"!=",Literal(NullLiteral("null"))),")",";")),Statement(RethrowStatement("rethrow",";")),"}"))))
